executive_summary: Maven build failed with 43 compilation errors due to missing Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons dependencies. The project requires these dependencies to be added to pom.xml to resolve package import failures across security configuration, repository interfaces, entity classes, and utility classes.

errors.message: Missing Spring Security dependencies: packages org.springframework.security.* do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is not declared in pom.xml, causing compilation failures for SecurityConfig class that requires HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, and EnableWebSecurity annotations.

errors.message: Missing Spring Data JPA dependencies: packages org.springframework.data.* do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency is not declared in pom.xml, causing compilation failures across repository interfaces (ColumnRepository, TaskRepository, UserRepository) that extend JpaRepository and use Page, Pageable, Query, and Param annotations.

errors.message: Missing Jakarta Persistence API: package jakarta.persistence does not exist
errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API is missing, preventing entity classes from using JPA annotations like @Entity, @Table, @Id, and @Column. This affects BoardColumn and potentially other entity classes.
errors.fix_recommendation: The jakarta.persistence-api dependency should be included transitively via spring-boot-starter-data-jpa. Verify the Spring Boot version in pom.xml is 3.x or higher. If using Spring Boot 2.x, upgrade to 3.x or add jakarta.persistence-api explicitly.

errors.message: Missing Apache Commons Lang3: package org.apache.commons.lang3 does not exist
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library is not declared in pom.xml, causing compilation failure in ValidationUtils class that likely uses StringUtils or other commons-lang3 utilities.

errors.message: Missing Spring Data domain classes: package org.springframework.data.domain does not exist
errors.root_cause: TaskManagementController imports Page and Pageable from org.springframework.data.domain, which are part of Spring Data Commons. This is included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa but the dependency is missing.
errors.fix_recommendation: This will be resolved by adding spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency as recommended in error #2. No separate action needed.

summary: 5 dependency errors found requiring 3 dependencies to be added to pom.xml
